feature: Panel group headings as the mock draws them
summary: Every group in the panel now has the mock's heading: a small capital title, a chip right beside it saying what it holds (Clip, Title, Media, an effect count), and its own button at the far edge. Properties ends in a three dot menu with Copy Look and Paste Look.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/dock-headers-walk.json.

try.do: Open a recording and click its clip on the timeline.
Read the Properties heading: PROPERTIES, a Clip chip beside it, three dots at the right.
Click the three dots and choose Copy Look.
Click the plus on the Effects heading and add a Shadow, then a Blur; the chip reads 2.
Choose View > Library, then fold the groups above Effects by clicking their headings.
Compare the headings with the video mock's dock.
Open a screenshot, measure something, and read the LAYERS and MEASUREMENTS headings.

evaluate: Do the small capital headings read as quieter than the rows under them, the way the mock intends, without getting hard to find?
Does a chip beside the title tell you what a folded group holds at a glance?
Is Copy Look and Paste Look what you expect behind the three dots on Properties, or do you want the mock's words, Copy properties?
With the grip gone, is it still clear you can drag a heading to reorder the groups?
rough: Pictures changed on purpose: the image panel takes the same headings (every image mock draws .dgrp-h too), so Layers, Measurements and the rest are small capitals and Measurements' count moved beside its title.
The Properties menu has Copy Look and Paste Look, the names the Layer menu already uses; the mock's Reset to defaults has nothing behind it yet and is filed as its own task.
The mock's header buttons sit on a faint round backing; the app draws the bare glyph.
The question marks on Properties and Fades are the app's own (asked for on 2026-09-25) and are not in the mock.
The mock's Graph group is not in the app; an open task covers the keyed value's curve.
The image mock's Layers heading has a count chip and a three dot menu; the image panel does not have them yet.
